title: Lead stages and your two pipelines

say: Stages show where every lead is. Pipelines keep different kinds of selling apart.
Stages बताते हैं हर lead कहाँ है. Pipelines अलग-अलग तरह की selling को अलग रखते हैं.
caption: Stages batate hain har lead kahan hai. Pipelines alag-alag tarah ki selling ko alag rakhte hain.

say: Stages सांगतात प्रत्येक lead कुठे आहे. Pipelines वेगवेगळ्या प्रकारची selling वेगळी ठेवतात.
caption: Stages sangtat pratyek lead kuthe aahe. Pipelines vegveglya prakarchi selling vegli thevtat.

say: Every lead sits in a stage, like Enquiry, Call back or Site visit booked.
Tap a stage tab to see just those leads.
हर lead किसी stage में होता है, जैसे Enquiry, Call back या Site visit booked.
किसी stage tab पे tap कीजिए, सिर्फ़ वही leads दिखेंगे.
caption: Har lead kisi stage mein hota hai, jaise Enquiry, Call back ya Site visit booked.
Kisi stage tab pe tap kijiye, sirf wahi leads dikhenge.

say: प्रत्येक lead एखाद्या stage मध्ये असतो, जसं Enquiry, Call back किंवा Site visit booked.
एखाद्या stage tab वर tap करा, फक्त तेच leads दिसतील.
caption: Pratyek lead ekhadya stage madhye asto, jasa Enquiry, Call back kinva Site visit booked.
Ekhadya stage tab var tap kara, fakt tech leads distil.

say: If your team sells two ways, say enquiries and partner outreach, each gets its own pipeline with its own stages.
Pick one, and To call and Start calling follow it.
अगर आपकी team दो तरह से बेचती है, जैसे enquiries और partner outreach, तो हर एक की अपनी pipeline, अपने stages.
एक चुनिए, और To call और Start calling उसी को follow करते हैं.
caption: Agar aapki team do tarah se bechti hai, jaise enquiries aur partner outreach, toh har ek ki apni pipeline, apne stages.
Ek chuniye, aur To call aur Start calling usi ko follow karte hain.

say: तुमची team दोन प्रकारे विकत असेल, जसं enquiries आणि partner outreach, तर प्रत्येकाची स्वतःची pipeline, स्वतःचे stages.
एक निवडा, आणि To call आणि Start calling तीच follow करतात.
caption: Tumchi team don prakare vikat asel, jasa enquiries aani partner outreach, tar pratyekachi swatachi pipeline, swatache stages.
Ek nivda, aani To call aani Start calling teech follow kartat.

say: Owners set them up on a computer, in Leads, Stages.
Sales X-Ray starts you with stages that fit your kind of business, and you can change them any time.
Owners इन्हें computer पे set करते हैं, Leads, Stages में.
Sales X-Ray आपके business के हिसाब से stages ready देता है, और आप इन्हें कभी भी बदल सकते हैं.
caption: Owners inhe computer pe set karte hain, Leads, Stages mein.
Sales X-Ray aapke business ke hisaab se stages ready deta hai, aur aap inhe kabhi bhi badal sakte hain.

say: Owners हे computer वर set करतात, Leads, Stages मध्ये.
Sales X-Ray तुमच्या business प्रमाणे stages ready देतो, आणि तुम्ही ते कधीही बदलू शकता.
caption: Owners he computer var set kartat, Leads, Stages madhye.
Sales X-Ray tumchya business pramane stages ready deto, aani tumhi te kadhihi badlu shakta.

say: Need another one? Tap New pipeline, give it a name, and pick its stages.
और एक चाहिए? New pipeline दबाइए, नाम दीजिए, और उसके stages चुनिए.
caption: Aur ek chahiye? New pipeline dabaiye, naam dijiye, aur uske stages chuniye.

say: अजून एक हवीये? New pipeline दाबा, नाव द्या, आणि तिचे stages निवडा.
caption: Ajun ek haviye? New pipeline daba, naav dya, aani tiche stages nivda.
